item: The panic CLI with the data drive absent or unidentified still erases what the app keeps outside the drive
summary: The precheck that ran before main.py's database import now runs the erase itself (asked first unless --yes): main_db_path names the main store from DATABASE_URL or the data folder without making or checking it when the database module cannot be imported (DataVolumeMissing/DataFolderErased), so the erase reaches the DATABASE_URL and OO_COLUMNAR_DIR stores and key files off the drive and leaves every store on the drive untouched (R809). A drive plugged in while the question waits is left whole (panic_wipe/quick_crypto_erase off_drive_only, report drive_returned); another program holding an off-drive store is said (no own pool in the CLI counts 0). Output: ERASE FAILED with S1/S5, Files erased outside the data drive N of M (or nothing found), the stores and keys on the drive were not erased; exit 2. Fresh-process tests: absent, other drive, unreadable marker, a no answer, nothing outside.
